glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 金 (“metal”) + phonetic 昔 – grindstone.
senses: [cuò] (in fixed expressions) bad; poor; inferior; substandard
[cù] (obsolete in standard Chinese) alternative form of 措 (“to place; to carry out”)
[xī] (chemical element, obsolete) alternative name for 鈰
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 錯; s_page_origin explains the simplified 错.
